headline: Argentina Restricts Chinese Telecom Equipment and Adopts US Security Standards
summary: Argentina's new cybersecurity directorate issued a regulation blocking Chinese companies from providing equipment to the public sector, aligning with US security standards with potential impacts on the cellular market.
why: Government restrictions on foreign technology vendors alter procurement dynamics and competitive landscapes for telecommunications infrastructure.

impacts.name: Telecommunications Sector
impacts.why: Excluding specific foreign vendors alters equipment supply chains and procurement costs for telecom operators.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical alignment and restrictions on major hardware suppliers introduce regulatory shifts for local telecom operators.
